title: TimeRLM: Recursive Language Models Enable Precise Anomaly Localization in Long-Context Time-Series
abstract: arXiv:2608.03391v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Precise anomaly localization over long-context time series is a crucial task in monitoring applications across clinical care, industrial operations, financial services, and logistics, where brief evidence may hide inside long spans of high-frequency data. Time-Series Language Models (TSLMs) are able to ingest time series data and verbalize findings on anomalies in natural language; however, recent benchmarks report a decrease in retrieval performance at long contexts, mirroring failure modes in text, vision, and audio. In the text domain, Recursive Language Models (RLMs) can recover much of this lost performance by keeping context external to the large language model (LLM), allowing the model to query it through code. We present TimeRLM, an RLM formulation for time-series that sequentially manipulates the signal using code and vision capabilities. We further introduce AnomalyXL, a synthetic long-context anomaly localization benchmark

translated_title: TimeRLM：递归语言模型实现长上下文时间序列中的精确异常定位
translated_abstract: 长上下文时间序列上的精确异常定位是临床监护、工业运营、金融服务和物流等监测应用中的一项关键任务，在这些场景中，短暂的关键证据可能隐藏在高频数据的长时段内。时间序列语言模型（TSLM）能够接收时间序列数据，并用自然语言表述其对异常的发现；然而，近期的基准测试报告显示，这类模型在长上下文下的检索性能会下降，这与文本、视觉和音频领域中的失败模式类似。在文本领域，递归语言模型（RLM）通过将上下文保持在大语言模型（LLM）外部，并允许模型通过代码对其进行查询，从而能够恢复大部分损失的性能。我们提出了 TimeRLM，一种针对时间序列的 RLM 形式化方法，它利用代码和视觉能力对信号进行顺序化操作。此外，我们还介绍了 AnomalyXL，一个合成的长上下文异常定位基准。
tldr: TimeRLM 提出了一种面向时间序列的递归语言模型方法，让大语言模型通过代码和视觉能力对外部信号进行顺序化操作，从而在长上下文时间序列中实现精确的异常定位，并发布了 AnomalyXL 合成基准数据集。
en_tdlr: TimeRLM introduces a Recursive Language Model formulation for time-series that enables precise anomaly localization in long-context data by leveraging code and vision capabilities to sequentially manipulate signals kept external to the LLM, along with the AnomalyXL synthetic benchmark.
